data.body: AC amendment (gap analysis): CLARIFY — migration-class ∈ {sweep,db,inconclusive} ONLY (per migration-class-marker.md); there is NO migration-class=flag value. The flag-pair wiring keys off the SEPARATE FEATURE_FLAGS marker (sibling c5fa) AND/OR the presence of flag-cutover+flag-cleanup role-tagged tasks — NOT a migration-class=flag value. The helper reads BOTH markers (MIGRATION_CLASS for sweep/db; FEATURE_FLAGS for flag) independently.
